newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wiener St'sche group H1 premium up 34pct.
newsitem.headline: Wiener St'sche group H1 premium up 34pct.

text.p: Austrian insurer Wiener Staedtische Allgemeine Versicherung AG said on Thursday group premium income rose 34 percent in the first half to 18.8 billion schillings ($1.8 billion) as life insurance products boomed.
Chief executive Siegfried Sellitsch said in a statement he expected a record year for 1996 but did not give further details.
"The business year 1995 was overall satisfying for the Wiener Staedtische, but 1996 will be a new record year," he said.
Wiener Staedtische said life insurance premium income more than doubled in the first half to 8.8 billion schillings.

Damage and accident premium income gained 1.5 percent to 8.224 billion schillings, while health insurance income slipped 0.9 percent to 1.718 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254 ($ = 10.61 Austrian Schillings)
